handcheck.selection_rule: first lexicographic nonzero M1 delta, then first distinct pair with nonzero M2 delta

zero_and_handcheck.zero_mass_rule: d45 == 0 contributes exactly 0 negative mass and is not negative; all d45 >= 0 rows have zero negative mass

decision: The registered +15→+45 corrected-delta gap rule is met by M1, M2; each also has positive point gaps on both adjacent transitions. Candidate-minus-M0 persistence remains after cancellation against M0 in these ten development games. This does not identify a behavioral mechanism or warrant changing the research workflow.

method.bootstrap_unit: whole game, equal weight, one shared matrix
method.permutation_unit: within start/team; shared cell order map across M1/M2

population.population_statement: Same frozen population as DIAG4: 10 development games, leave-one-whole-game-out predictions, 200 rollout starts (172 group-scored at +45), 2,164 +45 within-team pairs (1,064 Home / 1,100 Away), 142 EqualTeam +45 start/team cells; horizons are ordinal Image Id increments, **not seconds**; no independent tracking population; pairs and starts are not independent — every interval is the same 10-whole-game cluster bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 20261024, equal game weight, one matrix shared across all estimates.
population.timebase: ordinal Image Id increments, not seconds
